section-4-1.TO: appoint a person as the Domestic Abuse Commissioner (“the Commissioner”)

section-5-1.TO: make payments to the Commissioner out of money provided by Parliament for the purpose of enabling the Commissioner to meet expenditure incurred in the exercise of the Commissioner's functions

section-5-2.TO: be made at such times, and subject to any such conditions, as the Secretary of State considers appropriate

section-5-3.TO: pay, or make provision for paying, to or in respect of the Commissioner— (a) remuneration; (b) allowances; (c) sums by way of or in respect of pensions

section-6-1.TO: provide the Commissioner with— (a) such staff, and (b) such accommodation, equipment and other facilities, as the Secretary of State considers necessary for the carrying out of the Commissioner's functions

section-6-2.TO: — (a) consult the Commissioner, and (b) obtain the Commissioner's approval as to the persons to be provided as staff

section-6-3.BEFORE: providing any accommodation, equipment or other facilities

section-7-1.TO: encourage good practice in— (a) the prevention of domestic abuse; (b) the prevention, detection, investigation and prosecution of offences involving domestic abuse; (c) the identification of— (i) people who carry out domestic abuse; (ii) victims of domestic abuse; (iii) children affected by domestic abuse; (d) the provision of protection and support to people affected by domestic abuse

section-7-3.TO: do anything in pursuance of the general duty under subsection (1) that— (a) relates to a devolved Welsh authority, or (b) otherwise relates to Welsh devolved matters

section-7-4.TO: — (a) do something falling within subsection (2)(c), (d) or (e), to the extent that the thing done does not relate to Welsh devolved matters; (b) do something falling within subsection (2)(f) or (g); (c) disclose information to a devolved Welsh authority, or information which relates to Welsh devolved matters, under section 18

section-8-1.TO: report to the Secretary of State on any matter relating to domestic abuse

section-8-2.TO: publish every report made under this section

section-8-3.TO: send a draft of a report under this section to the Secretary of State

section-8-4.TO: direct the Commissioner to omit material from any report under this section before publication
section-8-4.IF: the Secretary of State thinks the publication of that material— (a) might jeopardise the safety of any person, or (b) might prejudice the investigation or prosecution of an offence

section-8-6.TO: arrange for a copy of any report published under this section to be laid before Parliament

section-9-1.TO: provide the Secretary of State with any advice or assistance that the Secretary of State may request

section-9-2.TO: provide advice or assistance relating to the exercise of any of the person's functions, or the carrying out of any activities by the person, in relation to people affected by domestic abuse
section-9-2.AT: the request of any other person

section-9-3.TO: charge a person for providing the person with advice or assistance under subsection (2)

section-9-4.TO: publish any advice given to a person under subsection (2)

section-9-5.TO: send a draft of what is proposed to be published to the Secretary of State
section-9-5.BEFORE: publishing any advice given under this section

section-9-6.TO: direct the Commissioner to omit anything contained in the advice before publication
section-9-6.IF: the Secretary of State thinks the publication of that material— (a) might jeopardise the safety of any person, or (b) might prejudice the investigation or prosecution of an offence

section-10-1.TO: do anything which the Commissioner considers will facilitate, or is incidental or conducive to, the carrying out of the Commissioner's functions

section-11-1.TO: issue a document (a 'framework document') that deals with matters relating to the Commissioner

section-11-3.TO: have regard to the framework document
section-11-3.WHEN: exercising any of the Commissioner's functions

section-11-4.TO: have regard to the framework document
section-11-4.WHEN: exercising any functions in relation to the Commissioner

section-11-5.TO: keep the framework document under review

section-11-6.IN: preparing or revising a framework document

section-11-6.TO: issue a framework document without the agreement of the Commissioner

section-11-7.BEFORE: issuing— (a) the first framework document under this section, or (b) any other framework document which is, in the opinion of the Secretary of State, significantly different from the framework document it replaces

section-11-8.TO: — (a) arrange for any framework document issued under this section to be published in the manner which the Secretary of State considers appropriate, (b) send a copy of the framework document to the Welsh Ministers, and (c) lay a copy of the framework document before Parliament

section-11-9.TO: lay before Senedd Cymru a copy of any framework document sent to them under subsection (8)(b)

section-12-1.TO: establish an Advisory Board (“the Board”) for the purposes of providing advice to the Commissioner about the exercise of the Commissioner's functions

section-12-2.TO: consist of not fewer than six and not more than ten members appointed by the Commissioner

section-12-3.TO: hold and vacate office in accordance with the terms and conditions of the member's appointment

section-12-4.TO: include— (a) at least one person appearing to the Commissioner to represent the interests of victims of domestic abuse; (b) at least one person appearing to the Commissioner to represent the interests of charities and other voluntary organisations that work with victims of domestic abuse in England; (c) at least one person appearing to the Commissioner to represent the interests of persons who provide, or have functions relating to, health care services in England; (d) at least one person appearing to the Commissioner to represent the interests of persons who provide, or have functions relating to, social care services in England; (e) at least one person appearing to the Commissioner to represent the interests of persons with functions relating to policing or criminal justice; (f) at least one person appearing to the Commissioner to have academic expertise in relation to domestic abuse

section-12-5.TO: pay such remuneration or allowances to members of the Board as the Commissioner may determine

section-13-1.TO: prepare and publish a strategic plan
section-13-1.AS SOON AS: reasonably practicable after the Commissioner's appointment

section-13-3.TO: — (a) state the Commissioner's objectives and priorities for the period to which the plan relates; (b) state any matters on which the Commissioner proposes to report under section 8 during that period; (c) state any other activities the Commissioner proposes to undertake during that period in the exercise of the Commissioner's functions

section-13-4.TO: — (a) prepare a strategic plan for a period immediately following the current period, and (b) publish that plan
section-13-4.BEFORE: the end of the period to which the strategic plan relates (“the current period”)

section-13-5.AT: any time during the period to which a strategic plan relates
any time during the period to which a strategic plan relates

section-13-6.TO: consult— (a) the Secretary of State, (b) the Advisory Board established under section 12, and (c) such other persons as the Commissioner considers appropriate
section-13-6.IN: preparing or revising a strategic plan

section-13-7.TO: arrange for a copy of any plan (or revised plan) published under this section to be laid before Parliament

section-14-1.TO: submit to the Secretary of State an annual report on the exercise of the Commissioner's functions during the year
section-14-1.AFTER: the end of each financial year

section-14-2.TO: include— (a) an assessment of the extent to which the Commissioner's objectives and priorities have been met in that year; (b) a statement of the matters on which the Commissioner has reported under section 8 during the year; (c) a statement of the other activities the Commissioner has undertaken during the year in the exercise of the Commissioner's functions

section-14-3.TO: arrange for a copy of every annual report under this section to be laid before Parliament

section-14-4.TO: direct the Commissioner to omit material from any report under this section before it is laid before Parliament
section-14-4.IF: the Secretary of State thinks the publication of that material— (a) might jeopardise the safety of any person, or (b) might prejudice the investigation or prosecution of an offence

section-15-1.TO: request a specified public authority to co-operate with the Commissioner in any way that the Commissioner considers necessary for the purposes of the Commissioner's functions

section-15-2.TO: comply with a request made to it under this section

section-15-4.TO: by regulations amend this section so as to— (a) add a public authority as a specified public authority for the purposes of this section; (b) remove a public authority added by virtue of paragraph (a); (c) vary any description of a public authority

section-15-6.TO: contain provision adding a devolved Welsh authority as a specified public authority for the purposes of this section

section-16-4.TO: include an explanation of— (a) the action which the relevant person has taken, or proposes to take, in response to the recommendation, or (b) why the relevant person has not taken, or does not propose to take, any action in response
section-16-4.IN RESPECT OF: each recommendation made in the report

section-16-5.TO: arrange for the comments to be published in such manner as the person considers appropriate

section-16-6.BEFORE: the end of the period of 56 days beginning with the day on which the report is published

section-16-7.TO: send a copy of anything published under subsection (5) to the Commissioner
send a copy of anything published under subsection (5) to the Secretary of State
section-16-7.WHERE: the relevant person is a specified public authority for the purposes of section 15

section-18-1.TO: disclose to a person any information received by the Commissioner in connection with the Commissioner's functions
section-18-1.IF: the disclosure is made for a purpose connected with a function of the Commissioner

section-18-2.TO: disclose any information to the Commissioner
section-18-2.IF: the disclosure is made for the purposes of enabling or assisting the Commissioner to exercise any function

section-18-4.TO: require or authorise any of the following— (a) the disclosure of any patient information (see subsection (5)); (b) the making of a disclosure which, although made in the exercise of a function under this Part, would contravene the data protection legislation (see subsection (6)); (c) the making of a disclosure which is prohibited by any of Parts 1 to 7 or Chapter 1 of Part 9 of the Investigatory Powers Act 2016

section-19-1.TO: exercise any function in relation to an individual case

section-19-2.TO: consider individual cases and draw conclusions about them for the purpose of, or in the context of, considering a general issue

section-20-1.TO: prepare and publish a report under section 8 on— (a) the need for domestic abuse services in England, and (b) the provision of such services
section-20-1.BEFORE: the end of the relevant period

section-20-4.TO: by regulations extend the relevant period for a further period of up to 6 months
